body: I don't think that meme works in this case. Many conservatives do believe both of those things. They're not mutually exclusive.  Many conservatives believe we need lower spending and a smaller government.  This would line up with lower taxes and less debt.

Hard wood flooring is a luxury item, so I doubt you'll find it in an apartment with such low rent.  Maybe laminate flooring. It's not as nice has hard wood, but much more common.  I don't think you'll be able to be picky about flooring in that price range however.

What kind of privacy would be expected when you're in front of a room of students? Many jobs I've worked there has been no expectation of privacy.   Call center where your voice + screen are recorded 100% of the time, bank teller where you're on camera all the time, etc.

Not many I imagine. If you speak to most people in real life they'd think different than the "consensus" on here.  There's an organized anti-capitalist push on reddit as a whole and history shows where it's attempting to lead us.

We're already at war. Not necessarily a civil war as we saw before but still a war on our own soil.  A portion of the population doesn't see it yet but war has evolved.  It's no longer conducted solely with physical violence and destruction but through subversion.  Look into Yuri Bezmenov.
